result_text:
I fixed all four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add tests or check the new patterns against sample files. I only ran the existing `Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer`, and they passed.

- **Generated HTML:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The old pattern listed `html` twice and never covered `.htm`.
- **Generated `.js` and `.xml`:** the `// Generated by …` rule and the `<doc>` .NET documentation rule now use `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`. Before, `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml` required a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`.
- **Gradle scripts:** the build-and-deployment rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so any `*-gradle.js` file matches. It used to require a literal `.-gradle.js`.

The content patterns are unchanged, so a hand-written `.htm`, `.js` or `.xml` file without the generator marker stays in the main scope.

I didn't commit anything.
